text:
Maya (Sales): Epoch POC - customer reports slow TTFT on long prompts and sporadic 429s when they ramp. Switching to private endpoint gives a 403. They want a short Dedicated trial price. Can we triage?
Ike (Solutions): paste the exact 403 text + a sample X-Request-ID. Which model and seq lengths?
Maya (Sales): auth: "403 egress_denied: not on allowlist". request id: rex-01a2. Model pinned: rw-instruct-compact. seqs ~1000-1400, ~6 clients spiking to 50 rps.
Rosa (SRE): likely two things: tiny client batch windows -> many small batches causing poor TTFT, and low KV cache hit_rate on the shard (check metrics). Ask customer to set client.batch_window_ms = 25-30ms and reuse session connections.
Ken (Security): 403 typically means their NAT IPs aren't listed for private egress. We need their allowed CIDRs and the completed security questionnaire (KMS/HSM requirement). If they accept managed keys we can fast-track.
Nora (Customer Success): I'll schedule a 30m troubleshooting call and include SRE + Oncall. We can offer a 7-day Dedicated demo while we investigate; will confirm pricing with finance.
Maya (Sales): I'll collect headers + SQ before the call and ask them to try batch_window=30ms. Posting results here after the session.
notes: short sales POC thread: TTFT, 429s, client batching, KV cache hit_rate, VPC 403, Dedicated demo pricing
